findings.highlight: I'm really not pushing myself too hard
findings.evidenceJa: 別に自虐とかじゃないぞ。本当にそう思ってる
findings.explanation: Haruki assures Setsuna that his wish for them to avoid further regret is not self-deprecation and that he sincerely means it. The English instead denies overexerting himself, an unrelated claim that removes the tonal clarification from his carefully drafted New Year's message.
findings.japanese:
『…別に自虐とかじゃないぞ。
本当にそう思ってる』
findings.todokanai: "…I'm really not pushing myself too hard, you know. I really mean that."

findings.highlight: doesn't pay any mind to the noise surrounding her, much like she did in the past
findings.evidenceJa: それでも杉浦は、もう以前のように、周囲の声を気にしなくなってしまった。
findings.explanation: Koharu no longer worries about other people's comments the way she did before; her behavior has changed. The English says her present disregard is much like her past behavior, reversing the before-and-after contrast and erasing Haruki's observation that her boundaries around him have shifted.
findings.japanese:
それでも杉浦は、もう以前のように、
周囲の声を気にしなくなってしまった。
findings.todokanai: But Sugiura doesn't pay any mind to the noise surrounding her, much like she did in the past.

findings.highlight: With an expression so sullen it's hard for me to watch, Sugiura stares at her food and pokes at it without even taking so much as a bite.
findings.evidenceJa:
杉浦は、こっちがいたたまれなくなるくらい
寂しそうな表情で、目の前の料理をつついては、
そのまま口に運ばずにぼうっと見つめてる。
findings.explanation: Koharu's expression is painfully lonely; the English calls it sullen, which can suggest resentment.
findings.japanese:
杉浦は、こっちがいたたまれなくなるくらい
寂しそうな表情で、目の前の料理をつついては、
そのまま口に運ばずにぼうっと見つめてる。
findings.todokanai: With an expression so sullen it's hard for me to watch, Sugiura stares at her food and pokes at it without even taking so much as a bite.

findings.highlight: the absolute lack of emotion she showed
findings.evidenceJa: 『成功祈ってます』に込められた感情が、何も見えてこなかった戸惑いのせいで。
findings.explanation: Haruki is unsettled because he cannot discern what emotion Koharu has put into 'I hope it works out.' The English asserts that she showed absolutely no emotion, replacing his fear of an unreadable feeling with emotional blankness and foreclosing the jealousy he is afraid to name.
findings.japanese:
『成功祈ってます』に込められた感情が、
何も見えてこなかった戸惑いのせいで。
findings.todokanai: Because I was so thrown off by the absolute lack of emotion she showed when she said, "I pray for your success."

findings.highlight: Your chance has finally come… after all
findings.evidenceJa: 今、そんな話することないじゃないですか。せっかく………なのに
findings.explanation: Koharu objects that they need not discuss Mihoko now, trailing off over the fact that she and Haruki finally have this time together. The English assigns the unfinished せっかく to Haruki's chance with Setsuna, making Koharu encourage the very romantic development whose interruption of their dinner has just distressed her.
findings.japanese:
「今、そんな話することないじゃないですか。
せっかく………なのに」
findings.todokanai: "Right now is not the time for this, is it? Your chance has finally come… after all."
